title: Tidy Timber Breeze

diffuser.notes: Run 30–45 min to refresh the room after tidying.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray linens/air, not skin.

why_it_works: Crisp fir and bright lemon cut through stale air, while a hint of spearmint keeps the blend clean and uplifting.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
